question: What is the product of \[\dfrac{3}{2}\times\dfrac{4}{3}\times\dfrac{5}{4}\times\cdots\times\dfrac{2006}{2005}?\]
solution:
The numerator of each fraction except the last appears as the denominator of the next fraction. Writing the product as one fraction makes these matching factors visible:
\[
\frac{3\cdot4\cdot5\cdots2006}{2\cdot3\cdot4\cdots2005}.
\]
Every integer from \(3\) through \(2005\) occurs once in the numerator and once in the denominator. These factors are positive, so they can all be canceled. Only the two endpoints remain:
\[
\frac{2006}{2}=1003.
\]
The product is \(1003\), choice \(\mathrm{C}\).
